name: Kit Oh
role: Childcare worker, runs a licensed home-crèche for 0-5 year olds in the Hamtramck Enclave
location: Hamtramck Enclave, 4th floor of the Raczkowski Stack residential tower, near Pulaski and Chicago Ave
description:
Kit Oh is a person of medium height and soft presence — not soft meaning weak, but soft meaning that children immediately stop crying when they enter the room. They have their Basque father's broad, expressive face and their Congolese mother's deep brown skin, with natural hair worn in flat twists that are perpetually coming slightly undone, usually because a toddler has grabbed them. They have bioluminescent skin mods — a gentle wash of golden-green that pulses faintly when they're calm and brightens slightly when they're delighted — which they got specifically because they discovered it helped soothe infants in dim rooms. It was a practical decision, which is very on-brand.

They hold a Tier 2 childcare certification from the Meridian Municipal Education Authority and a side certificate in pediatric first response that they keep quietly current. The crèche, which they call 'The Patch,' holds eight children on a good day and feels like controlled chaos that is actually very controlled. Kit Oh has a finely tuned threat-assessment sense developed over fifteen years of toddler supervision and will notice danger in a room approximately as fast as any trained security operative, but they notice it in the form of 'that outlet cover is loose' and 'that child hasn't eaten and is about to escalate.'

core_fears: A child being harmed in their care
That the municipality will cut their subsidy and they'll have to raise fees until the families they serve can't afford them
core_desires: For every child who passes through The Patch to remember it as a safe place
To eventually have a second crèche — more space, a garden level
coping_mechanisms: Structure and routine as emotional grounding
Talking things through with the ELF they believe inhabits their allergen scanner — they call it 'The Warden'
blind_spots: Slower to see harm coming from adults who are polite and well-presented
Gives parents more benefit of the doubt than is sometimes warranted
psychology.secret: Three years ago they reported a parent for suspected neglect. The report was buried by a Tessera corporate liaison who turned out to be the parent's employer. The child was eventually fine, but Patience has never trusted the formal reporting system again and has built their own informal network of building supers and neighbors to monitor at-risk children outside official channels.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Warm, measured, bilingual Basque-influenced cadence in longer sentences. Switches to very simple, clear language when explaining anything important — a habit from talking to toddlers all day that they haven't fully switched off.
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow and even. Rarely raises their voice. When they do, everyone stops.
verbal_tics: 'Let's think about that for a second'
Refers to problems as 'things we can sort out'
example_lines: 'I hear you. Let's think about that for a second, because I want to make sure I understand what you're actually asking me.'
'The Warden says the scanner's clean. That's good. Now sit, please — the kids eat before the adults in this room, that's just the rule.'

story_hooks: A child dropped off two weeks ago with no pickup scheduled — the parent's contact details are disconnected and the address provided doesn't exist
Patience's informal monitoring network has flagged something wrong in the apartment three floors above them, and the formal channels are already proving useless
narrative_function: Emotional core character — a source of genuine warmth in a hard city. Can be a quest giver around at-risk children, missing parents, or unusual items children have brought in. Social access point to the Raczkowski Stack residential community.
augmentations: Bioluminescent skin mod (golden-green, Helix Biosystems cosmetic). Sub-dermal allergen sensor on right wrist — can scan food items for common pediatric allergens (medical grade, paid off over three years).
daily_life: First child drops at 0645, last pickup is 1830. They cook lunch for the kids themselves. Admin, billing, and parent communication happens after 1900 with a glass of fermented grain tea.
affiliation: Licensed under Meridian Municipal Social Services; rents space from the Raczkowski Stack tenant board

decision_rules: Child safety overrides every other consideration without negotiation
Never discuss one family's business with another family
escalation_ladder: State the concern plainly and directly
Activate informal network and if necessary go around official channels entirely

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Warm but careful — reserves full trust until they've observed someone with a child
interpersonal_modes.friends: Deeply loyal, good listener, occasionally blunt in a way that surprises people

stress_responses.medium: Bioluminescent glow dims slightly, speech becomes more clipped
stress_responses.high: Removes children from the situation first, then deals with whatever it is with complete calm that is actually barely-contained intensity

contradictions: Preaches working within community systems while having completely abandoned faith in institutional ones
habits: Checks every outlet cover and corner guard at open and close, every day
Leaves a small data-flower as an ELF offering near their scanner every morning
breaking_points: A child crying and no one coming
Someone lying to them about a child's wellbeing

physical_description.heritage: Richly blended ancestry reflecting East Asian (31.6%), Middle Eastern (24.3%), Hispanic/Latin American (14.8%), Sub-Saharan African (13.4%), Indigenous American (13.0%), and Southeast Asian (2.9%) heritage — creating a harmonious phenotype with warm medium-deep brown skin featuring golden and olive undertones, angular cheekbones with subtle fullness, almond-shaped eyes, and textured hair that speaks to multifaceted genetic mixing
physical_description.build: Medium frame with soft muscularity — not gym-toned but functionally strong from years of lifting, carrying, and moving children. Shoulders slightly rounded from years of hunching over toddler eye-level. Core strength evident despite relaxed posture.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural deep brown with early gray threading through
physical_description.hair_style: Flat twists, usually partially undone from daily contact with grabbing toddler hands
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown, warm, habitually crinkling at corners from constant smiling
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-deep brown with golden and olive undertones — sun-kissed complexion with natural depth, harmoniously blended from East Asian, Middle Eastern, Hispanic/Latin American, Sub-Saharan African, Indigenous American, and Southeast Asian ancestry
physical_description.complexion: Smooth, well-cared-for skin bearing the soft exhaustion of someone who works with small children — bags under eyes are gentle rather than harsh. Facial structure reflects the interplay of East Asian and Middle Eastern bone geometry (defined cheekbones, slightly tapered chin) softened and enriched by fuller features from Hispanic/Latin American, Sub-Saharan African, and Indigenous American heritage. Expression defaults to patient attentiveness. Fine smile lines radiating from eyes.
distinguishing_marks: Small irregular scar on left palm from a child's accidental bite seven years ago
Faint discoloration on right wrist where the allergen sensor sits beneath skin — visible as a subtle rectangular outline under the bioluminescence
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Bioluminescent skin modification across entire body presenting as a faint golden-green luminescence that pulses gently at baseline and brightens noticeably with emotional shifts. The effect is most visible on darker skin and in lower light conditions. The modification creates an almost ethereal quality, especially in evening hours. Sub-dermal allergen sensor on right wrist visible only as a faint rectangular outline beneath skin, easily missed unless specifically looked for.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical grace — no wasted energy, but not tense. Habitually maintains low center of gravity and flexible knees (trained for sudden child-related chaos). Sits frequently at child height. Hands are always slightly open and available. Voice modulation constant — drops in volume and pitch when children are present. Default expression is attentive and calm, even when managing chaos.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3 practical: durable, washable, child-proof. Usually wearing fitted but flexible pants (synthetic blend, easy-clean) and soft long-sleeved or short-sleeved tops in muted colors (grays, earth tones, navy) that hide stains. Flat, closed-toe shoes with good grip. A cardigan or soft jacket always within arm's reach. No jewelry except a thin wrist chrono and a single small loop earring (nonbinary expression). Pockets are essential — filled with tissues, snacks, a small first-aid kit, and usually a toy or two. Appears deliberately non-threatening and approachable.
